title: Inter can't afford an experiment against Shakhtar
caption: Inter lead Serie A and have zero points in Europe — 29th of 36, per inter.it. La Gazzetta dello Sport expects Ivan Provedel to start against Shakhtar on Wednesday with Josep Martínez rested, and says it isn't a call made on merit.
